description: Machine-readable artifact inventory for OSS FIPS-path validation inputs. Lists the files and path patterns that belong to the bounded OSS FIPS-aligned posture. This manifest is consumed by release and compliance automation to deterministically scope TLS, KMS, image, wording, and evidence checks without treating all Vault Community files as FIPS-path content.
classifier_note: This manifest does not imply that Vault Community is FIPS 140-3 validated, certified, or compliant for its internal cryptographic operations. See FIPS-140-3-COMPLIANCE.md for the authoritative OSS posture boundary.

hcl_config.description: FIPS-path Vault HCL listener and seal configuration examples

helm_values.description: FIPS-path Helm chart values for Kubernetes deployments

markdown.description: Markdown posture artifacts including compliance documentation, operator guides, and release notes that are subject to the overclaim wording gate

evidence.description: Audit-ready FIPS compliance evidence package — must be updated each release and verified within 90 days

wording_inputs.description: Scripts and configuration files scanned by the OSS wording guardrail for prohibited FIPS claim language
